head_coach.name: Thomas Tuchel
head_coach.play_style_summary: A highly structured, energetic, and vertical approach that combines defensive compactness with aggressive counter-pressing, rapid direct transitions, and fluid rotations to unlock elite attacking talent.

key_players.name: Jude Bellingham
key_players.performance_stats: Averaged an 88% pass completion rate, 1.8 key passes, and 1.5 tackles per game, providing a dominant box-to-box and creative attacking presence.

key_players.name: Harry Kane
key_players.performance_stats: Finished as Europe's top clinical striker, averaging 1.3 shots on target, 41.3 touches per game with 62% in the final third, and outstanding hold-up play.

key_players.name: Cole Palmer
key_players.performance_stats: Maintained an 85% pass accuracy, averaging 2.2 key passes per match and proving highly clinical with a record of multiple first-half hat-tricks.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Sustained an Achilles tendon injury at the end of the domestic season, causing him to miss team training and casting doubt on his availability.
Ruled out for the tournament after suffering a significant knee ligament injury with Arsenal.
Sidelined and officially excluded from the squad due to a severe thigh injury suffered in late April.
Unavailable for squad selection due to a foot injury.
